data.name: Rajju
data.gender_notes: Rajju is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raj means king and ju means little. This name is derived from Sanskrit and has its roots in Hinduism. It is a unisex name and carries themes of nature, power, sun, and the concept of a king. The name Rajju carries the meaning “Little King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rajju usually hope their child will grow to embody little king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the presence of royalty and power within, often associated with spiritual leaders and those who hold a position of authority.
data.etymology: Rajju belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajju total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
